title: Open from Git
hint: Choose a saved project repository, branch and optional directory. Review its exact revision before adding it to this browser.
fork_hint: Your next Save uses a dedicated working branch. A repository with read-only access uses a personal or organization fork when supported.
limits: Initial browser limits: 1 MiB per file, 2 MiB per snapshot. Import fails without replacing existing projects if browser storage is full. Larger assets need separate storage support.
identity_reused: The saved project identity is unused in this browser and will be retained. Backend deployment history requires a matching repository registration.
identity_copy: This import receives a new identity. Existing local projects and their unsaved edits are preserved.
seed_hint: Import stores this reviewed snapshot locally. The next Save creates the working branch from this exact commit, preserving other repository files. The selected branch stays unchanged.
status_structured: Structured authoring verified: VM, network, content and bundle forms match the saved generated files. Renew any allocation before deploying; allocation ownership is local to its original browser.
status_files: This project has canvas and files, with no generated scenario ownership. Save preserves those files until you explicitly configure a scenario.
status_legacy: Legacy snapshot: no structured authoring metadata was saved. Canvas and files can be opened; VM/network/content forms cannot be reconstructed reliably from playbooks.
status_conflict: Structured authoring cannot safely take ownership of these files. They may contain manual edits or use a different compiler version.
files_only: Open canvas and files only. Preserve the reviewed files and discard generated-path ownership; reconcile or create scenario configuration explicitly before generating again.
source_changed: The Git source or selected backend changed. Preview the project again with the current connection.
files_notice: Opened with canvas and files only. Save preserves existing scenario files; structured authoring must be configured explicitly.
